name: orders-web
description: Example web brick: the shop's orders page. Its pages are published on 127.0.0.1:<webPort> (platform.json); it reads the orders through the router, from the server (GRAPHQL_URL) and from the browser (PUBLIC_GRAPHQL_URL). Its source is apis/orders-web; build the image with: docker build -t plugbricks-example/orders-web:0.1.0 apis/orders-web
